# Objective

Replace the group view's derived (irregular) first-char boxes with a **fixed
5×5 zone grid**, and make the label system **all letters**: `HintCharacters`
loses `;'`,/` (25 letters, A–Z minus Q), the 25 zone keys are those letters in
scan order, and the second keystroke is also letters-only. Confirmed with the
user 2026-08-14: 5×5 / all 25 letters (nothing dropped) / letters-only second
level.

# Design

Zone-based label assignment for grid sessions (all-`PointHint`), replacing the
ordinal-sorted scan-order assignment there:

- Level 1: session bounds sliced 5×5 (`ZoneService.SliceIntoZones` reused);
  zone i's key = `HintCharacters[i]` (scan order). Boxes are the regular zone
  rects (empty zones draw no box).
- Each point's label first char = its zone's letter (containment by
  `BoundingRectangle`); second char = `HintCharacters[j]` cycling in emission
  order within the zone. Zone with exactly 1 point → 1-char label (type the
  zone letter, instant fire). Labels stay unique + prefix-free.
- Labels are zone-based for BOTH views (full + group) so `<leader>p` never
  relabels mid-session. Zone-mode sessions keep scan-order labels (their own
  drill UX; the zone ctor opts out).
- **Overflow safety valve**: if any zone would need more than
  `HintCharacters.Length` second chars (dense layouts concentrate points), the
  session falls back to today's scan-order labels + derived boxes.
- **Grid cap**: with a valid zone spec the grid cap becomes
  `zones × chars` (25×25 = 625) instead of `chars²` (625 < 841 → the grid
  coarsens ~16%, step ≈58 px @1080p uniform, was ≈50) so zones fit the second
  char budget by construction on even layouts.
- Config: new hot-reload `GroupZones` = `"5x5"` (cols x rows; blank/invalid or
  cols×rows > char count → the v1 derived-group mode). `HintCharacters` value
  becomes `ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPRSTUVWXYZ`.
- Punctuation keys (`; ' , /`) leave the label set → they pass through to the
  app again (hook captures them only when configured).

# Files (as touched)

- `Services/GroupViewService.cs`: `TryParseZoneSpec`, `EffectiveGridCap`
  (pure), `TryAssignZoneLabels` (pure; labels + regular boxes in one call,
  false/null on zone overflow; cell-index math with clamping, not
  Rect.Contains, so boundary points land deterministically).
- `Services/HintLabelService.cs`: `ReadHintCharacters` became internal so the
  VM reads the set once per overlay.
- `Services/UiAutomationHintProviderService.cs`: `EnumGridHints` cap =
  `EffectiveGridCap(chars, GroupZones)` — applies to every grid it generates
  (monitor, window, quadrant, zone-mode lens fills), so non-groupable grids
  (e.g. taskbar-merged) also coarsen to the 625 cap. Accepted trade-off.
- `ViewModels/OverlayViewModel.cs`: spec parsed once per ctor (0x0 when
  invalid/oversized; the zone ctor never sets it, so zone-mode sessions keep
  scan-order labels); `LoadSession` tries zone labels first, falls back to
  `GetHintStrings`; `_zoneBoxes` stored per session so `ToggleGroupView`
  restores the ZONE boxes (not derived) when re-enabling.
- `App.config` (`GroupZones=5x5`, letters-only `HintCharacters`),
  `OptionsViewModel.cs` + `OptionsView.xaml` (GroupZones field),
  `CLAUDE.md`, `GroupViewServiceTest.cs` (+7 tests).

# Fix round 1 (on-box 2026-08-14, "it's still one row with multiple cols")

The first zone-grid build silently fell back to the v1 tall strips. Two
defects, both fixed in `6a9cf41` (+ test-expectation fix `c2f80ff`):

1. **Zone overflow → silent fallback.** The cap loop accepted a global count
   (627 points, guard-exhausted, maxHints 625) whose 5×5 zones held up to 28
   points vs a 25-char second-char budget (reproduced by arithmetic:
   spanEdges rounding on 1920×1080 gives 33×19 points; the ceil-split into 5
   columns/rows yields 7×4 = 28). `TryAssignZoneLabels` failed → `LoadSession`
   fell back to scan-order labels + derived boxes = the v1 strips the user
   saw. Fix: the cap loop now coarsens until the LARGEST zone fits the budget
   (`MaxZoneCount`, guard 10); a simulation of the exact `FillRegion`
   spanEdges math converges in 2 rounds to 29×16 = 464 points, max zone 24
   (~65 px step on 1080p).
2. **Absolute-vs-relative coordinates.** Zone lookup subtracted
   `bounds.Left/Top` and boxes were emitted at absolute origins, but PointHint
   rects and HintCanvas are session-RELATIVE — on any monitor not at (0,0)
   every point clamped into zone 0 and boxes drew off-canvas. Fix: bounds is a
   pure size; lookups divide br.Left/Top directly; boxes are relative.

CI note: run `31794460021` failed on the new regression test — its expected
labels were copied from the same-zone case (AA/AB); two points in DIFFERENT
single-point zones are each labeled by their key alone (A, B). The code was
right; the assertion was fixed. Run `31794575390` green.

# Fix round 2 (on-box 2026-08-14, "F1..F4 still one row with multiple cols" + centering)

1. **Quadrant sessions fell back.** Quadrant construction sets
   `OwningWindowBounds = monitor` (full screen, for the full-screen overlay)
   after rebasing the quadrant's points into monitor space
   (`ShellViewModel` quadrant builder). Bounds-based zone slicing therefore
   tiled the whole monitor while all points clustered in one quarter — the few
   occupied monitor-zones held ~4× the 25-char budget → overflow → v1 strips.
   Fix (`5c2249d`): zones tile the hints' **EXTENT** (`HintExtent`, union of
   their render rects) everywhere — monitor, window, quadrant.
   `TryAssignZoneLabels` and the provider cap loop's `MaxZoneCount` both slice
   the extent, so loop and assignment agree by construction. Quadrants now get
   their own 5×5 grid inside the quadrant.
2. **Centered key char.** The box key-char pill moved from the box's top-left
   corner to its CENTER: a corner pill sits exactly where box boundaries meet
   (ambiguous ownership at a glance), and centered matches the zone-zoom pick
   view (labels at zone centers) and reads as the target.

Zone tests rewritten for extent semantics (2×1 zones over hand-computable
extents; the quadrant shape is covered by a cluster-away-from-origin test).

# Fix round 3 (2026-08-14, user requests + agreement check)

1. **Uniform 6×4 per zone (zone-aligned generation).** The user observed mixed
   6×3 / 6×4 in-zone layouts — arithmetic confirms: the global 29×16 lattice
   doesn't split evenly into 5×5 zones (29/5 and 16/5 leave uneven chunks).
   Agreed with the goal; implemented as zone-ALIGNED generation rather than
   patching the split: while a zone spec is active, the grid is
   zoneCols×inCols by zoneRows×inRows spanEdges over the bounds, so every zone
   holds exactly inCols×inRows points and overflow is impossible by
   construction. inCols/inRows derived from the bounds aspect (near-square
   cells, ≤ the second-char budget) with the layout's centerStep as a density
   floor (small windows stay sparse but uniform). 16:9 + 25 letters → 6×4=24
   per zone, 30×20=600 total (~66×57 px on 1080p; verified by simulation:
   per-zone counts = {24} uniformly). Superseded machinery removed
   (`MaxZoneCount`, `EffectiveGridCap`). Documented side effects: GridLayouts
   presets / dense regions don't apply while zoned; zone-zoom's lens fill is
   zone-aligned too.
2. **`<Space>` no longer clears the typed prefix.** The old clear's stated
   reason ("so the next key is read as a command") is void — dispatch branches
   on `_leaderPending` (`OverlayKeyboardHook.Dispatch` checks it before label
   chars), so the prefix never intercepts leader keys. Preserving it keeps the
   drilled zone's level-2 labels after a mid-drill mode switch
   (`<Space>r` → still inside K). Snapshot/select 2-picks already cleared on
   entry (verified in their bodies), giving the safe composition.

1. Unit tests: spec parse (12 cases), cap math (valid/invalid/oversized),
  label assignment (zone-key first char, second char cycling, single-point
  zone → 1-char label, boundary determinism, edge clamping, overflow →
  false, degenerate inputs, RELATIVE coords with a non-zero-origin bounds),
  MaxZoneCount (max / clamp / degenerate), TryGridZoneSpec fit.
2. CI green: `31793000138` (initial), `31794575390` (after fix round).
3. Shipped config grep: `HintCharacters=ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPRSTUVWXYZ`,
  `GroupZones=5x5`, `GroupViewEnabled=true`.
4. Drops: `hap-zonegrid` (initial), **`hap-zonefix`** (fix round, current).
5. On-box matrix (user, pending): 25 regular boxes; type zone char → that
   zone's points with letter second chars; 2nd char fires; single-point zone
   fires on the zone char alone; `; ' , /` pass through to the app;
   `<leader>p` round-trip keeps labels stable; Esc ladder; monitor cycle;
   Automation unchanged.
